limitations.note: The rewrite registered `valid_b` but also made `ready_a` high during reset, allowed input on the first clock after reset, and suppressed `valid_b` on a stall at count 5, whereas the reference preserves registered readiness and samples `cnt == 5` regardless of `valid_a`.

The test exercised reset and a gap before the sixth bit, but its scoreboard required the rewrite's always-high readiness and transfer-only valid pulse, so it passed without exposing either reference mismatch.
